title: Operator decision
description: One question put to the operator and, once answered, the operator's answer (the decisions row, docs/proposals/0019-lead-logic-in-system.md section 2.7, D109). `id` is the studio's next number, one sequence for the whole studio, taken by the store when the question is recorded and never reused: a record is never deleted, and a correction is a new record whose `supersedes` names the old one. An `asked` record has no answer; an `answered` one has it, who recorded it, and when. A lead may record an answer only on the operator's word, naming where the operator said it in `source`. It is evidence of what the operator said, not a grant of authority (INV-6). Egress classification: operator-shared.

id.description: `D<n>`: the studio's decision number, from one sequence, never reused.

projectId.description: The board project the question is about; absent: a studio-wide decision, read by every lead.

state.description: asked: waits for the operator; answered: the answer is recorded and the record no longer changes.

options.description: The choices put to the operator, at most 20.

recommendation.description: What the one asking recommends, and why, in a few words.

links.description: Where the question comes from: an ADR, a task id, a commit, a document path, at most 20.

askedBy.description: Who recorded the question: `operator`, `lead:<project>`, or `import` (the one-time import of the lead's registry).

answer.description: The operator's answer, in the operator's words as far as they are known.

answeredBy.description: Who recorded the answer: `operator` (the operator gave it) or `lead:<project>` (a lead wrote down the operator's word, with its `source`), or `import`.

source.description: Where the operator said it: a message, `/ui`, a review. Required when `answeredBy` is a lead.

supersedes.description: The decision this one corrects; the old record stays as it was.

importedFrom.description: The file a record of the one-time import was read from: present exactly when `askedBy` is `import`.

allOf.description: An answer a lead recorded names where the operator said it.
A question or answer recorded by the import is a record of the import, which names its file.
Only a record of the import names a file, and its question was recorded by the import.
